arguments.summary: A credential compromise occurred on host WS-FIN-AP01 originating from external IP 185.220.101.42. The attack began with a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, leading to the execution of a malicious DLL via rundll32 from the Temp directory. Network telemetry confirmed Cobalt Strike beaconing to C2 infrastructure at 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to file server WS-FIN-050 after failed Kerberos TGT requests. The EDR flagged multiple TTPs including T1566.001, T1218.011, T1071.001, and T1565.001. Full remediation was performed using Ansible playbook 'remediate_cobalt_strike.yml', including process termination, artifact removal, and host isolation. A full EPP scan detected a low-severity PUP but no primary malware payload.

arguments.summary: A credential compromise occurred on host WS-FIN-AP01, initiated via a phishing email that triggered an encoded PowerShell command from Outlook.exe. This led to the execution of a malicious DLL using rundll32.exe from the user's Temp directory. The payload established C2 communication over TCP/443 to 198.51.100.23 and modified the host file. Initial reconnaissance from external IP 185.220.101.42 was observed scanning internal assets, but no direct link to the compromise was confirmed. Response actions were denied due to insufficient approval context.

rule Suspicious_Rundll32_Temp_Load {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from user Temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-12"
    strings:
        $temp_path = /\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]+\\.dll/i
        $rundll32 = "rundll32.exe" fullword ascii
    condition:
        $rundll32 and $temp_path
}

arguments.summary: A credential compromise occurred on host WS-FIN-AP01 originating from a phishing email that delivered a malicious PowerShell payload. The payload executed via Outlook, launched an encoded command, and loaded an unsigned DLL through rundll32 from the Temp directory. This led to a C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23:443. The external IP 185.220.101.42 was previously observed conducting an Nmap SYN scan against an internal IT host (WS-IT-101) but was not blocked at the perimeter. Despite detection by EDR, containment actions (firewall block, EPP quarantine, IAM lockout) were denied due to policy or misalignment with incident evidence.
